## Separate complete bounded control for typed arithmetic on an integer model default.
app NumericControl
Given
 Job { count:int=1 }
 policy Job read=public
When
 crud Job by=public fields=count
 scenario increment(job:Job) by=public -> int
  do return job.count+1
